summary: Round 4 recheck (00:45-01:30 UTC 26 Sep). It picks three closed or orphaned ideas that rounds 1-3 did not cover. Rounds 1-3 already covered floatout, I-077/78, tempfuse, swapfix, clip-boundary, axis-flip, RE-AIM/pair-GBM/BYTE, the runtime-rejected ideas, DNVETO and ANTIPAR. None of the three revives, and there is no plan change. (A) I-035 / C09 / E12 head-shift scale s: an orphan that was never run. Its CPU desk test was run now on the 199-video head captures. s_opt is about 0.75-1.0 on both embryos. At s = 1.33 the mean distance is 1.7% worse on 44b6 and 2.6% worse on 6bba, so the pre-registered gate (s_opt >= 1.25 and >= 4% gain) fails decisively. In addition, x138's refine raises 'invalid V1284 displacement' for any shift above 2 um. Close it. (B) Refined-duplicate collapse was dropped in v2 because 'the head does not make pairs converge'. It was re-checked because lowrefine (new in K2) head-refines the readmitted peaks. On the dummy CSVs, lowrefine adds only 12 same-frame pairs under 3 um out of 121,252 nodes, and none of them has a GT node within 4 um. The effect is about 1e-5, so it stays closed and lowrefine has no duplicate risk. (C) Leaf prune on x138 was closed in v3 section i. It has a new fact since round 3: P36 = 0.954 = #35 (delta 0), which closes it under the pre-registered read (|delta| <= 0.001). The stated revival arguments (private node multiplier, the lab's node-count bias) do not survive R4, f2 or the P36 rule. A CPU replay on exp60 (arms 0.3 and 0.5) was launched as a calibration point. Its result was NOT in before this answer, so the main session or curator should read it from the scratchpad. Side fact: y3uanm's 0.956 secondary fine-tune has no public weights, so the C10 successor-port route is empty.

findings.what: I-035 / C09 / E12: multiply the public V1284 head shift by s in 0.8-1.6. OLD VERDICT: kept as 'idle only' in v3 section c row 13 (TASK_CLOUD_SESSION T12 gate: continue only if s_opt >= 1.25 and the gain is >= 4% on BOTH embryos). It was never run, so it became an orphan (curator: 'close explicitly or run the desk test before R8'). WHAT CHANGED: nothing favourable. The runtime headroom is irrelevant (0 GPU cost), and the head weights name 's075' had suggested the targets were shrunk by 0.75, i.e. s_opt ~1.33. MEASURED NOW on CPU in 33 s, using the public head on the captures: 199 videos, 313,205 peaks, fixed 4 um Hungarian pairs, excluding the 20 probable x138 head-training stems. Mean distance to GT (um) for s = 0 / 0.75 / 1.0 / 1.15 / 1.33 / 1.5 / 2.0: 44b6 1.490 / 1.312 / 1.301 / 1.306 / 1.323 / 1.350 / 1.479; 6bba 1.733 / 1.577 / 1.577 / 1.589 / 1.618 / 1.658 / 1.844. The 4 um re-match count peaks at s = 0.75 on both embryos. A larger s shrinks the 6bba z bias (0.45 -> 0.32 um at 1.33) but inflates the y/x bias (0.42 -> 0.49), so the net effect is worse. The kernel's refine also raises RuntimeError('invalid V1284 displacement') for any shift above 2.00001 um, so s > 1 would crash refinement on bounded-near-2 um peaks unless the guard were changed too. NEW VERDICT: CLOSED by measurement. The gate fails decisively (s_opt < 1.25; s = 1.33 is 1.7% / 2.6% worse). The head-cascade variant falls with it.

findings.what: Refined duplicate collapse. OLD VERDICT (v2 Dropped): the head-free variants measured -0.002 to -0.013, the oracle was +0.0004 / +0.0020, and 'the head does not make pairs converge'. WHAT CHANGED: K2 (F1) now carries lowrefine, which moves readmitted and lowdet peaks >= 0.965 onto head coordinates. Those are exactly the peaks the ILP discarded, often as second detections of an accepted nucleus, so convergence onto main nodes was plausible. MEASURED on the dummy CSVs (same-frame nearest neighbour, voxel 1.625/0.40625/0.40625 um). K1 exp58t = exp56: nodes in pairs < 1 / < 2 / < 3 / < 4 um = 2 / 18 / 58 / 446 of 121,219. K2 exp58 and twin exp58n: 4 / 26 / 82 / 465 of 121,252. Unique pairs under 3 um: 29 -> 41, which is +12, or 0.01% of nodes. None of the 20 new pair keys has a GT node within 4 um (unannotated regions), so there is no evaluable edge harm, and the node-multiplier exposure is ~1e-5. NEW VERDICT: STAYS CLOSED. Lowrefine does not create a material duplicate problem, so this is no risk to the K2 read (d1) and needs no rider.
